declaration.declared_before: any forward feature builder, forward seal or forward label for Strategy E Trading V1.1

principle.daily: information available no later than the close of D-1
principle.minute: bars starting at or before 09:24 ET of D, plus complete earlier sessions
principle.chronology: each forward session may add only D-1 to the daily context; reading future daily rows in bulk is forbidden
principle.future_violation: FutureContextViolation; the session is not a valid forward observation
principle.no_fabrication: missing context is never filled, defaulted, taken from a later date, or converted into H5 = False

close_d_minus_1.source: grouped daily adjusted=false, T=symbol, field c
close_d_minus_1.missing: FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE if the D-1 grouped file is absent; symbol not daily-eligible if its row is absent from a present file (E0 semantics)

membership.source: reference tickers CS snapshot (historical_v2 reference infrastructure; forward/massive/reference/CS_<as_of>)
membership.as_of: latest snapshot dated on or before D-1
membership.missing: FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE; a snapshot dated after D-1 is a FutureContextViolation

median_dollar_volume.missing: a missing grouped file inside the window is FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE; a symbol absent from present files counts as not present (E0 semantics)

split_exclusion.as_of: published before 09:25 ET of D for LIVE; RECONSTRUCTED may use a later list but reads only execution_date <= D
split_exclusion.missing: FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE unless the list covers executions through D

premarket_block.source: minute aggregates adjusted=false, 1-minute, forward/massive/minute/<SYMBOL>/<SYMBOL>_<D>.json.gz or Common Raw pages
premarket_block.missing: a page not fetched is FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE; a fetched page with no premarket bar means no premarket row (not eligible), as in E1

premarket_rvol.lookback: back from D-1 until 20 qualifying sessions (a bar in [04:00,09:24] and a 09:30 bar, positive premarket dollar volume) or the symbol's first collected session; undefined below 5
premarket_rvol.missing: an unfetched page inside that range is FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE; fewer than 5 qualifying sessions in a complete history is Research-undefined (NaN)

spy_premarket_return.source: SPY minute page of D and SPY close(D-1) from grouped daily
spy_premarket_return.missing: SPY close(D-1) or SPY's D page not fetched is FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE; SPY printing nothing premarket is Research-undefined (NaN)

daily_snapshot.first_forward_session_context: USB-HIST-V1 grid 2024-09-17..2026-09-16 supplies D-1 = 2026-09-16 and its 21-session window
daily_snapshot.later_sessions: grouped daily for 2026-09-17 onward must be collected into market_data/forward/massive/grouped_daily/<year>/<session>.json.gz and appended one session at a time; not collected as of 2026-09-21
daily_snapshot.splits: the frozen split list covers executions 2024-09-16..2026-09-16 only; every forward session needs forward/massive/splits/splits_asof_<D>.json.gz covering executions through D; none collected as of 2026-09-21
daily_snapshot.reference: latest CS snapshot in the store is CS_2026-07-01; valid as the latest snapshot on or before D-1 for current forward sessions

minute_history.historical_source: Common Raw minute pages (market_data/raw/massive/minute) for sessions <= 2026-09-16
minute_history.forward_source: forward/massive/minute pages, or Common Raw pages where B collects the same session
minute_history.coverage_requirement: whole D-1 daily-eligible universe (forward protocol section 13); partial coverage makes the session FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE and INVALID as forward evidence
minute_history.known_gap: historical minute coverage is 1,612 of 2,936 daily-eligible symbols in the broad window; uncovered symbols have no RVOL history until it is collected

live_vs_reconstructed.LIVE: seal written before 09:30:00 ET of D from inputs fetched by 09:25; PRIMARY evidence
live_vs_reconstructed.RECONSTRUCTED: built after the close from the same sources truncated at the cutoffs; SECONDARY evidence
